address: Level 4, Park Regis Birmingham, 160 Broad St,B15 1DT
bio: Whether you are looking to celebrate a special occasion, or simply want to enjoy some decadent treats, Afternoon Tea at 1565 Restaurant, Bar & Terrace is an experience you will remember.  Afternoon Tea at Park Regis Birmingham is a sophisticated affair and features a selection of the finest sourced ingredients and the best taste fusions. Their Classic Afternoon Tea menu includes an array of sandwiches, homemade scones and pastries, all accompanied with a carefully sourced selection of teas.  Think bright colours, edible flowers, delicious flavours and a sprinkle of signature sparkle. The Classic and Children’s Afternoon Teas have been reimagined to the highest standard by the dedicated pastry chefs, to delight all of the senses. Children can tuck into sparkling candy floss clouds whilst grow-ups enjoy gooey gold-laced brownies. This Afternoon Tea in Birmingham is a great way to make memories.  Also served in the hotel's glittering 1565 Bar & Terrace, their new INDUS Afternoon Tea brings you a menu infused with traditional Indian savouries and sweets, echoing the flavours, spices and textures of Northern India. Delight in pan Asian flavours, which will take you on a culinary journey across northern India, exploring the richness of tastes, contrasts and textures of the region that has been synonymous with centuries of tradition.  For those looking for something a bit different, the fabulous 1565 Outdoor Terrace allows guests to enjoy the cityscape throughout the year.  Find the 1565 Restaurant, Bar & Terrace in the Park Regis Hotel Birmingham, just minutes' walk from Five Ways Train Station and 10 minutes' walk from Birmingham New Street.
